   - The number of states (`jjnewStateCnt`) has decreased from 66 to 61.
   - Various `kind` checks and state transitions have had their indices adjusted based on the removal of `SQUOTED` and previous token enumerations.

This relationship ensures that the token parsing logic will interpret query tokens correctly without the ambiguity of single-quoted tokens in queries, which was the intent of fixing the cited issue (SOLR-4121).
